assessment_objectives.objective: Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) are categorized as "High Risk" if they pose a significant risk of harm to an individual's health.
Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) are categorized as "High Risk" if they pose a significant risk of harm to an individual's safety.
Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) are categorized as "High Risk" if they pose a significant risk of harm to an individual's fundamental human rights.
